ticks.note: Tick 1 sets the initial values; the self-loop is delayed.
`lowest min= 40` keeps the smaller of 1000 and 40; `highest max= 40` the larger of 0 and 40. `count++` adds 1 and `doubling *= 2` doubles.
75 is not below 40, so `lowest` stays 40; `highest` becomes 75.
12 is the new lowest; 75 stays the highest.
`reading` keeps its value, 12. Nothing new for `lowest` and `highest`, but `count` and `doubling` change in every tick.
